section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.5 Demographics) describes the demographic data collection procedures for the study. Participants self-reported their age and confirmed their female gender, and were asked to provide information on educational qualification, ethnicity, and country of residence using predetermined drop-down menus. Educational categories ranged from 'Some high school' to 'Graduate degree', but no actual demographic statistics or sample characteristics are reported in this section.
